;Business and economy
*[[Economy of Argentina]]
**[[Argentina]] hikes interest rate to 60%, the highest in the world, as its currency plunges. [https://money.cnn.com/2018/08/30/news/economy/argentina-interest-rates-currency/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Economy of the United Kingdom]]
**[[Panasonic]] announces their intent to move their [[Europe|European]] headquarters from [[London]] to [[Amsterdam]], citing concern over [[Brexit]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-45351288 (BBC)]
**[[Wonga.com|Wonga]], the largest [[payday lender]] in the [[United Kingdom]], collapses into [[administration (law)|administration]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-45359395 (BBC)]
*[[Crisis in Venezuela]]
**The [[Petro (cryptocurrency)|petro]], a Venezuelan government-backed [[cryptocurrency]], has not been trading and is not publicly accessible, despite government claims that it has sold $3.3 billion worth of units and the fact that it is linked to the nation's [[Sovereign Bolivar|physical currency]] and wages. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-cryptocurrency-venezuela-specialrepor/special-report-in-venezuela-new-cryptocurrency-is-nowhere-to-be-found-idUSKCN1LF15U (Reuters)]
*[[United States–European Union relations]]
**[[European Commissioner for Trade]] [[Cecilia Malmström]] proposes to reduce all [[European Union]] import tariffs, also on automobiles, to zero if the [[United States]] reciprocates. [[President of the United States]] [[Donald Trump]] threatens to quit the [[World Trade Organization]]. [http://www.lesoir.be/175854/article/2018-08-30/tarifs-douaniers-trump-juge-que-loffre-de-lunion-europeenne-sur-lautomobile-est (''Le Soir'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*A military helicopter crashes in the [[Oromia Region]] of [[Ethiopia]], killing 18 people. [http://koaci.com/m/ethiopie-helicoptere-militaire-secrase-avec-personnes-bord-aucun-survivant-122801-i.html (FANA BC via ''Koaci'')]
*A bus crash in [[Karoo]], [[South Africa]], leaves ten people dead and 30 injured. [https://www.thesouthafrican.com/beaufort-west-bus-crash-death-toll/ (''The South African'')]
*[[2018 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**The [[National Hurricane Center]] issues advisories for what forecasters call a Potential Tropical Cyclone Six. If it strengthens to a tropical storm, it would be known as [[Hurricane Florence|Florence]]. [http://www.sun-sentinel.com/news/weather/hurricane/fl-reg-tropical-weather-aug-28-story.html (''Sun Sentinel'')]
*At least eight people are reported dead and many sent to hospitals after a bus crash on a [[New Mexico]] highway. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-45361670 (BBC)]

;Law and crime
*The [[First presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]] is considering sending captured [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] fighters to a prison in [[Iraq]], as well as sending "high-valued fighters", who participated in the murder of Americans and other Western hostages, to the [[Guantanamo Bay detention camp]]. [[Human rights group]]s and the [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic Party]] are opposed to holding these people indefinitely without charges and say they should be tried in [[Federal judiciary of the United States|federal courts]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/storyline/isis-terror/trump-admin-may-send-captured-isis-fighters-iraq-prison-guantanamo-n905066 (NBC News)] [https://www.nbcsandiego.com/news/national-international/Trump-Admin-ISIS-Fighters-Iraq-Prison-Guantanamo-492090491.html (NBC San Diego)]

;Politics and elections
*Protesters against [[Mayor of London]] [[Sadiq Khan]] plan to fly a balloon of him in which he is wearing a yellow [[bikini]] over [[Parliament Square]], [[London]] on 1 September in the same spot where the [[Donald Trump baby balloon]] was flown on 13 July. [https://chicago.suntimes.com/news/london-mayor-bikini-blimp-trump-baby-balloon/ (''Chicago Suntimes'')] [https://www.inquisitr.com/5050847/protestors-plan-to-fly-sadiq-khan-blimp-in-same-spot-that-trump-baby-was-flown-during-us-presidents-visit/0 (Inquistr)]
*[[Trans Mountain Pipeline]], [[Premiership of Justin Trudeau]]
**A [[Federal Court of Appeal (Canada)|Canadian court]] overturns [[Prime Minister of Canada|Prime Minister]] [[Justin Trudeau]]’s decision to expand the [[Trans Mountain Pipeline]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/aug/30/trans-mountain-pipeline-latest-canada-court-overturns (''The Guardian'')]

;Science and technology
*The [[Japanese space agency]] announces their schedule for the exploration of [[162173 Ryugu]] by their ''[[Hayabusa2]]'' probe. [https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-45363130 (BBC)]
